_schema._comment: Manual overrides win over auto-synced data in models.json. Each key is a model id (matching a key or alias in models.json). The value is a partial capability/metadata object that is deep-merged onto the registry entry AFTER auto-sync. Use this for fields that cannot be inferred from public benchmarks: tool_calling.reliability, aliases, or an explicit track override. Remove the _schema key is not required — it is ignored by the loader (keys starting with '_' are skipped). Example below is commented out via the _example wrapper.
